notes.title: Fix-It Friday's Bug Report: Things We're Working on Patching
notes.content:
Hey there, survivors!

It’s Fix-It Friday, so you know what time it is! Our developers are always hard at work polishing the Eden Falling Alpha, so to give you a peek behind the scenes we wanted to outline some of the bugs that the team is currently patching. 

Some of the known issues that our team is currently working on fixing include:

[list]
[*] Loading delays between the tutorial and the settlement
[*] Resolution drops on loading screens if the game is minimized
[*] Feet clipping through the ground in the alleyway
[*] Disappearing pool cue in the bar
[*] A screen in the Merchant amenity clipping through the door
[*] Some model issues on NPCs while listening to the Harbingers band perform
[*] NPC limbs clipping through objects in the Merchant and Bathhouse amenities
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/7fe91616ab5fd36d187a34bee79ee225d7494175.png[/img]
[i]The merchant amenity is one area receiving a lot of TLC at the moment.
[/i]

We can’t wait to share more updates with you as these bugs get ironed out!

In the meantime, we encourage you all to hop into the Alpha to help us polish Eden Falling into the best game it can be! If you do enter the Alpha, be sure to send us all your constructive feedback here:

notes.title: An Update on the Status of Eden Falling's Graphical Overhaul
notes.content:
Hey there, survivors!

As you might remember, at the beginning of this year we announced that Eden Falling would be undergoing a significant graphical overhaul as we process the game through the High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP) tool.

Since it’s been ongoing for a couple months now, we just wanted to reassure you that things are progressing smoothly and to ask for your patience for a little while longer! As a reminder of where Eden Falling’s visuals stand right now, here are some snapshots of how the environments look currently, pre-HDRP conversion:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/af1cb992fe997dcddf23e3706768607a2956cbc3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Patch Updates for Eden Falling Alpha
notes.content:
Happy Tuesday, survivors!

We’ve been busy implementing a lot of fresh features and bug fixes into the Eden Falling Alpha lately, so we wanted to give you a quick rundown on what’s new in case you missed it! 

Across the last few patches, we’ve had all sorts of snazzy new updates, including:
[list]
[*] Lens bootup SFX added to intro cutscene
[*] Targeting Reticule SFX was fixed to play properly
[*] Bar Music - no longer plays during character creator
[*] Removed enemy runaway camera for better visibility in the tutorial
[*] Glitching object materials resolved in Bar
[*] Updated Settlement scene
[*] Fixed wolf spider death ragdoll timing
[*] Moved a few NPCs around in the main menu scene
[*] Gender selection dissipation effect now added in to transition away from the selection and into the cinematic
[*] Tutorial contract drone not clipping through buildings anymore, just comes straight down and straight back up

So if you haven’t had a chance to hop into the Alpha in a while, now’s the perfect time to jump back in and see what’s changed! Plus there are a lot more exciting things to be added in the near future as well of course 😉.

notes.title: Eden Falling New Build and Game Engine Upgrade
notes.content:
Last Updated: 08/12/2021

[h1]In The Afterfall...[/h1]
[h3]upgrading can save your life.[/h3]

Salutations to all the Brave Souls who Accepted the Challenge and ventured through the overgrowth, defeating wandering marauders, mutated spiders, and maybe even enjoyed a few moments in the bar to smooth out the rough edges that come with surviving day-to-day in Eden Falling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/b5c6ca678dbf3fdc9d8ecb051bef23808f1383f2.jpg[/img]

We wanted to let you know the latest build of Eden Falling will be pushed out soon, but after this build, there will be a temporary delay in game updates as we are upgrading our game engine.

This will allow us to utilize better-than-ever features to run the game faster and more efficiently. 

Which means more fluid gameplay, better fidelity, and smoother gameplay with high def graphics. And when we’re ready to implement multiplayer, the improved engine’s network code will mean smoother rollout and let us focus more on design and balance. 

We are ecstatic to hear how many of you are enjoying the game and are looking forward to the new and exciting updates we have in store.

We also want to sincerely thank the thousands of testers who are enjoying Eden Falling and we are appreciative of all the constructive suggestions, tenacity, and enthusiasm! 

Thank you once again for your patience and we hope you continue to enjoy our game!

notes.title: Found a bug? Report it here! + Patch Notes
notes.content:
With the launch of the Eden Falling pre-alpha demo, we want to make sure that your feedback is seen by our devs. If you've found any bugs while playing the demo, fill out this Google Form to report it and our team will send the issues to the right folks so they can begin building a better experience for our players!

[url=https://forms.gle/C88EYALDhPwcFLCJ7]Report Bugs Here!
[/url]
Do your best to describe the bug in detail, including what actions you took leading to the discovery of the bug. Make sure to check out the changelog and instructions below to make sure your game is up-to-date.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/727660/discussions/0/3081006600721101539/]List of known issues here.[/url]

Thank you for playing the Eden Falling pre-alpha demo. We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: EDEN FALLING - 2020 Updates
notes.content:
Fellow Survivors!  We are alive and well, despite all that the Afterfall has thrown at us.
The road has been long and the challenges vast, but we at Razor Edge Games are committed to bringing you a game that fulfills the promises that have made to our fans. We are uncompromising in achieving our vision, and unlike certain AAA studios which shall remain nameless, we are not interested in delivering an inferior product just to capitalize on hype.
We appreciate your patience, and we promise that it is not in vain.
 
Since our last update we have made numerous revisions and updates to ensure our game is as engaging and immersive as possible. These improvements encompass every department of our production, and including but not limited to the following:

[list]
[*] Improved environments and level design. Coding enhancements have enabled us to create interactive scenes, and properly implement cover and other combat elements. Environments are modularly generated, allowing for endless exploration and unique play-through experiences, but also regionally aligned, meaning that every area has its own dangers and strategic approach.
[*]Fully integrated weather effects which not only provide their own challenges and dangers, but which also affect the world at large. Did a meteor shower or spore storm pass over your favorite settlement? You’d best pray they survived the experience!
[*]Settlements, the precious pockets of relative safety for survivors of the Fall, have been modulated to allow ~100k possible unique locations. Every friendly location you explore will have its own technological level, unique NPCs, available quests, amenities, and more.
[*]Coding for the complex quest system has been completed, allowing for 10s of thousands of possible quests and contracts. An adaptive quest delivery and reward system means that no playthrough experience will be the same; quests have triggers and story branches which can depend on world state, season, faction alignment, and other player-based and environmental factors.
[*]Completely revamped User Interface to improve player experience. All map and navigation elements are in place, as well as place of interest and settlement amenities. Our world is primed to explore using an intuitive and engaging menu of choices and control.
[*]The combat module is complete. Enemy and friendly NPC AI now accounts for available cover, concealment, wound level, morale, and relative intelligence. Expect your opponents to respond to environmental cues and exploit the same advantages or disadvantages you would!
[*]The combat camera has been fully implemented, allowing players to witness their success or failure through an exciting, cinematic lens. Issue commands to your character and followers using a turn-based (but time-sensitive!) system and watch the action unfold.
[*]Working VFX now include plasma and laser weapon graphics, dynamic environmental lighting, realistic water effects, holograms, and holographic displays. We’ve overhauled all textures and shaders to increase immersion; characters, objects, and the environment reflect wear, accumulation of dirt, and damage.
[*]Character animation has been improved to a level of detail that includes lip-synced speech, hair, and clothing. Character and NPC models also adjust to reflect their attributes and stats.
[*]Cleaned up and streamlined a TON of code, reducing overall system requirements without sacrificing quality. Scene loading times have been cut nearly 80% to minimize the time players spend waiting to explore new regions or places of interest.
[*]Video recording and playback system is in place, allowing for players to record their most epic moments and visceral combat encounters. Post your stories and videos to the community forum to share your experiences with other survivors.
[*]We’ve expanded the marketing department to maintain a more active presence on social media and keep our growing fanbase better informed. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram to stay abreast of changes, and watch for the emergence of our playable demo!
[/list]
  
Last but not least, we’ve revamped our website. [b]Check it out here![/b]
https://razoredgegames.com/
